verdict.rationale: Airwallex does run some recurring operations on a schedule: recurring invoices and multi-frequency subscriptions bill automatically (e.g. annual plus monthly charges). Its AI tooling is a different matter. AgentOS runs multi-step workflows on demand, and the CLI is pitched for scripting repeatable tasks and plugging into automated systems, but nothing shows a built-in way to schedule an agent workflow or job, so you would need an external scheduler such as cron. Missing for 10: native scheduling of AgentOS workflows or skills, scheduled or recurring transfers and payouts, a general job scheduler API, and hands-on corroboration.
